case.query: I have two separate questions: If my doctor suspects I have a hormone disorder, what types of samples can be tested to measure my hormone levels? I had mild COVID-19 but still feel tired months later. Can people who only had mild illness develop long-term symptoms?
evidence: Laboratory tests can measure the hormone levels in your blood, urine, or saliva.
Anyone who had COVID-19, whether it was severe or mild, can have long-lasting symptoms.
